visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of a prepared dish in a bowl, featuring stir-fried instant noodles topped with sliced pan-fried chicken thigh, chopped green onions, and stir-fried cabbage. The lighting is bright indoor lighting, and the background is a blurred white surface. (2) The scene cuts to a black cast-iron pan where a hand wearing pink gloves uses tongs to flip a marinated chicken thigh. The chicken skin is golden brown. Green onion stalks and garlic cloves are added to the pan, followed by a large amount of chopped green cabbage layered on top. (3) The pan is uncovered to show the softened vegetables. A white bowl pours a liquid seasoning (soy sauce/mirin) over the ingredients. Then, pre-cooked instant noodles are added with tongs and stirred to absorb the pan juices. (4) The finished meal is shown again in a serving bowl, looking identical to the opening shot with fresh green onion garnishes. (5) A woman with long reddish-brown hair, wearing a black sleeveless top, appears in an indoor dining setting. She holds the bowl toward the camera with an excited facial expression. She uses a fork to take large bites of the chicken and noodles, showing expressions of intense enjoyment with closed eyes and nodding. She ends by giving a thumbs-up to the camera.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 練完琴餓得要死. (2) [Subtitle]: 來做一個雞排炒泡麵. (3) [Subtitle]: 醃雞排的配方: 白胡椒粉、五香粉、味醂、醬油、蒜頭. (4) [Subtitle]: 首先把醃好的雞排呢先煎一下. (5) [Subtitle]: 再來把蒜頭還有蔥爆香. (6) [Subtitle]: 倒入大量的蔬菜之後上蓋燜煮. (7) [Subtitle]: 登登~打開來之後呢. (8) [Subtitle]: 撒一點點鹽巴以及味醂、醬油之後把(先燙過的)麵丟進去. (9) [Subtitle]: 吸飽這個湯汁之後起鍋撒上青蔥就好啦. (10) [Subtitle]: 我跟你講真的超級好吃. (11) [Subtitle]: 醃過的雞腿排真的無敵. (12) [Subtitle]: 多汁. (13) [Subtitle]: 然後那個香煎過的雞排的皮也會有一個油脂香味. (14) [Subtitle]: 再來這個蔬菜已經吸飽了雞汁. (15) [Subtitle]: 超甜. (16) [Subtitle]: 超脆口. (17) [Subtitle]: 然後這個麵也是一樣吸滿了雞汁. (18) [Subtitle]: 超級好吃的. (19) [Subtitle]: 無敵爆炸享受. (20) [Subtitle]: 而且又非常的簡單一鍋到底超方便. (21) [Subtitle]: 大家來試做看看吧.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a cheerful female voice narrating in Mandarin over an upbeat, acoustic pop BGM with a prominent guitar rhythm. The narrator's tone is friendly and high-arousal. (2) As the video shows the chicken being flipped, a distinct sizzling sound of frying meat is audible, layered beneath the narration and music. (3) When seasonings are added, the narrator's pitch fluctuates to emphasize specific ingredients. A metallic clinking sound of tongs hitting the pan occurs twice. (4) A splashing sound accompanies the pouring of sauce, followed by the wet texture sound of noodles being mixed. The acoustic energy increases as the cooking process reaches its peak. (5) In the tasting segment, the narrator's voice becomes more expressive and breathy to convey pleasure. Audible chewing sounds and the light clatter of a fork against the bowl provide a sensory, ASMR-like quality to the review. The BGM remains consistent until the end.
